title: Revealing Hidden Mechanisms of Cross-Country Content Moderation with Natural Language Processing

bias_targets.methodology: Training classifiers to predict content moderation (censorship) decisions on Twitter datasets from five different countries (Germany, France, India, Turkey, Russia) and using Shapley values to extract and compare the most influential entities driving moderation in each geopolitical context.

Comparing the refusal rates and types of censored topics (e.g., historical political movements vs. religious freedom) between two different LLMs (DeepSeek R1 and GPT-4o-mini) using a publicly available dataset of politically sensitive queries.
